question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Between**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• About: On the subject of, or connected with. (के विषय में, या उससे जुड़ा हुआ)
 
• Beside: At the side of; next to, or in addition to. (के पक्ष में; इसके आगे या इसके अतिरिक्त)
 
• Between: In or along the space separating two objects or regions. (दो वस्तुओं या क्षेत्रों को अलग करने वाली जगह में या साथ में)
 
• Among: In the middle of or surrounded by other things. (बीच में या अन्य चीजों से घिरा हुआ)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: During September and November is the most fantastic time for visitors to visit Tawang.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "between" is the most appropriate option.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete passage: *The monastery in Tawang has recently undergone (1) renovation__ and bright paintings __(2) adorn__ its walls. Dances and ceremonial celebrations are held in the __(3) courtyard__, the most important of which is held on the night of Buddha Purnima, the full moon on which the Buddha was born, __(4) __*__*attained*__ *enlightenment and died. To reach Tawang, you drive for 12 hours from Assam’s Tezpur town, a major Indian Forces base. The best season the visitor can choose for coming to Tawang is **__(5) between__** September and November.*
